# Return contract — `investigation`

<!-- Generated by generate_agent_definitions.py; do not edit. -->
<!-- delivery-version: b257a1a89279be5e17cda3c133aa77b8c4d2706c 2026-11-07T11:18:12+01:00 -->

Return a JSON object with `status`, `claims`, `open_questions`, `read_receipts`, and `missing_evidence`, plus `refusals`.
Each claim carries `statement`, `evidence_tier` (exactly `reproduced`, `instrumented`, `read`, `reported`, or `inferred`), `citations` as `path:line` references, and `reproduction` recording what was attempted and what happened.
A claim carries no severity and needs no changed-line anchor: the subject is a reported symptom, not a defect in reviewed material.

An observation and a diagnosis are different returns.
What was seen is a claim; why it happens is a hypothesis, and an unestablished hypothesis belongs in `open_questions` with what was tried, never promoted to a claim by inference and never dropped because it could not be settled.

After a complete read with no claim to make, return `status: complete`, `claims: []`, and `empty_result: NO_FINDINGS`, retaining the receipts.
Missing evidence or unread ranges require `status: incomplete` and never the clean empty token; a failed, truncated, or refused return is not an empty result, and a refusal requires `status: refused` with `refusals` populated.
